title: "Teaching"

This page contains topics that I have developed lectures or other teaching material for during my graduate studies. The aim is to introduce readers to important topics related to my research.
These topics include:

- Optimization
- Support Vector Machines
- Distributed Machine Learning

In the near future, I will upload and discuss materials relating to each in the sections below


## Optimization

Material covering topics in mathematical optimization.

## Support Vector Machines

Lectures covering the theory and implementation of support vector machines.


## Distributed Machine Learning

Material on distributed machine learning.
